headers._comment: MUST STAY AFTER THE /(api|auth) BLOCK ABOVE. Vercel applies every matching headers block and the later one wins, so moving this up restores no-store on images and nothing visibly breaks - the bill does. An uploaded image is immutable (128 random bits in the key, never rewritten under it) and is fetched on every view of every published site; when the bytes live in MongoDB rather than a bucket, no-store makes each of those a function invocation and a full read. Vary: Cookie is dropped deliberately: an image that varies by cookie is one the CDN is not allowed to cache. Pinned by test/csp-test.js.
